speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this right knee swelling, and has it been painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia B (Factor IX deficiency).

The 18-month-old history of spontaneous right knee swelling after minor trauma, combined with a maternal uncle affected by similar bleeding disorders, strongly suggests an X-linked recessive bleeding disorder. To confirm this, I need the results of a coagulation profile.

REQUEST TEST: PT/INR, aPTT, Factor IX activity level, and Factor VIII activity level.
